in_hebrew.name: Tallou
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tallou הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word ‘tallos’, which means mountain or hill. This name is often given to those who live in mountainous regions or are believed to possess the strength and resilience of a mountain.
